verdict: Leads are arriving; a tracking gap is hiding them from the report.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your pipeline shows 74 contacts and 40 opportunities created in the CRM — demand is real. The leads figure reads zero on this report because attribution between your ad platforms and the lead-tracking metric is broken, and that repair is already underway. On the ad side, Google spend totaled $1,450.96 this period but ran on an on/off cycle due to a daily budget cap, which is why some days show zero activity alongside others that ran normally; this is a budget-structure issue, not a sign that campaigns stopped working. Google Ads still logged 14 conversions this period, and your Google Business Profile engagement rose 23% week-over-week, keeping organic momentum positive. Through the end of August, intake ownership is being confirmed and the booking automation is being tested — both unlock the next phase of scale-up heading into heating season.

highlights.phrase: contacts received in the last 28 days per your CRM — demand is present despite the tracking gap
Google Business Profile actions (calls, directions, website clicks) generated organically this period
Google Ads conversions recorded in the last 28 days, with $1,450.96 in total ad spend

watch_item.issue: Zero appointments are logged against 74 contacts this period, pointing to a gap in how leads are being booked after they arrive.
watch_item.fix: The booking automation is being tested and intake ownership is being confirmed by August 31 — both are required before increasing ad spend.
